blurb: Guests can board horses with daily care including grain twice daily, hay three times daily, and stall cleaning. Birthday parties include one hour of pony rides followed by one hour for pizza, cake, and presents. Parents may arrive 30 minutes early to decorate the facility.
bring: Pizza, cake or cupcakes, and beverages for birthday parties (families bring their own)
